Requirement 3 (Issue #21356: SequentialFeatureSelector.fit() groups parameter)
Describe the workflow you want to enable

SequentialFeatureSelector allows specifying a cross-validation splitter via the cv parameter in the constructor, but does not allow the groups parameter in fit() so group-based cross-validation cannot be used.

 Describe your proposed solution

Add a groups parameter to SequentialFeatureSelector.fit() to allow groups to be passed into the cross-validation splitter:
 

This will need to be passed through to _get_best_new_feature() and then to cross_val_score().
